# Armored Walkers

The same animal family in English: the zine's four captions of the
Selected Taxonomy, the moves as a die-bulleted list, the illustration on
the back. The deck prints `de` and leaves it out. Invented for this
deck — a family of no published bestiary.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: dino-island
  card-type: taxonomy
  language: en
data:
  name: Armored Walkers
  description: "Armored herbivores that would rather dig in than run."
  occurrence: In pairs, the young between them
  instinct: Dig in and wait
  moves:
    - Tail club
    - Bury its head in the sand
    - Refuse to be moved
  genera: Saichania, Pinacosaurus
  image: "[[Panzerlaeufer.png]]"
  reference: Zine p. 28
```
